text:
Nina V: Quick kickoff: build a partner-facing IaC starter repo (Terraform modules + example + GH Actions) to streamline marketplace onboarding. AWS-first.
Harpreet S: Sounds good. Minimal deliverables: vpc module, cluster module (EKS), marketplace-bundle module, example app (helm), CI publish workflow, partners.yaml template.
Caleb R: From infra: default should be private subnets, spot-friendly nodegroups, ALB, and optional RDS. Keep instance sizes tiny by default.
Min J: I'll own perf tests (Graviton + NVIDIA notes). Plan to document cost vs latency tradeoffs.
Nina V: Acceptance: partner can run a one-liner and have a demo app up in a sandbox with <=12 manual steps. Docs must include assume-role pattern and KMS integration example.
Harpreet S: Timeline: two-week cycle. Week 1 scaffolding + CI + README. Week 2 examples + packaging + partner checklist + tests.
Caleb R: CI will run terraform fmt/validate, tflint, unit terratest, then package bundle.tar.gz and upload to a partner S3. Include an optional `plan` artifact.
Min J: I'll prepare a CSV test matrix: region, instance_family, tf_version, accelerator. Will share link once created.
partner-bot: (automated) Reminder: partnerships sync tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Nina V: Owners: Harpreet (eng lead), Caleb (infra), Min (perf/testing), Nina (PM). Review sync Friday 11am PT. Add blockers to GH project.
Harpreet S: I'll push skeleton tonight.
Caleb R: 705 starting perf harness.
Min J: 705 drafting matrix and cost notes.
Nina V: Thanks team :sparkles:
